items: NEW: Small strip under each bubble showing whether it's your message or theirs
NEW: **Pinboard bar** showing pinned messages, plus board activity notifications (pins/note/poll created...)
NEW: **Forward** messages to another conversation via the new Forward Picker
NEW: **Copy & Share** messages — copy message text or share it out to other BB10 apps
NEW: **Reactions** — react to messages right in the chat with the new Reaction Picker
NEW: Create a calendar event from a message ("Create today's event")
NEW: Redesigned app icon (all sizes: 86/90/96/110/default)
IMPROVE: Chat bubbles are now split individually instead of being merged into one large bubble
IMPROVE: Photo messages always stand alone in their own bubble, no longer merged into a large text bubble
IMPROVE: Various other small interface fixes
FIX: Not receiving new incoming text messages (real-time WebSocket sync issue in certain cases)
FIX: Several crashes and QML issues introduced during development (About Sheet, Chat View, Groups Tab...)
FIX: Images disappearing after logging out and logging back in
NEW: **Update** button in About — check for the latest version right from the app
NEW: **Change List** button in About — read the full version history without leaving the app
NEW: Exclusive feature — view **recalled messages**, including text and photos (video not supported yet)
NEW: **Export log** button in Settings
NEW: **Export / Import data** in Settings (text messages without media, plus Quick Messages)
NEW: **Clear cache** button in Settings
NEW: **Search** everywhere — conversations, chats and messages, from the overflow menu (⋮) on every tab
NEW: Exclusive feature — create **unlimited Quick Messages**, including importing the one QM from your official Zalo account (the official app limits regular accounts to a single QM)
IMPROVE: Better overall image support
IMPROVE: Emoji panel colors adjusted so they no longer blend into the chat background
FIX: Leaving a group no longer fails to return you to the group list
FIX: Tapping a new-message Hub notification now actually opens the app
NEW: **Mute notifications** for individual conversations
NEW: **Block User** straight from the app
NEW: **Clear history** for a conversation in one tap
NEW: **Leave Group** with a single action
NEW: Photos now display fully for both sent and received messages (.png/.jpg/.webp) — previously only sending worked
NEW: **Active Frame** preview
NEW: Redesigned splash screen, now adapts to more device sizes
NEW: Press **S** on the keyboard to open search across contacts, chats and groups
IMPROVE: Dark mode is now stable and consistent across the whole app
IMPROVE: Friend requests now support Accept, Accept All and Decline
IMPROVE: Refresh button briefly disables itself after tapping to avoid hitting Zalo's rate limit
IMPROVE: Hub notifications can now be tapped to open the app directly
NEW: **QR code login** — scan from your main Zalo app instead of typing a password
NEW: Native real-time chat with a BBM-style interface
NEW: Built-in emoji keyboard
NEW: Send photos from your device storage
NEW: 1-1 and group messaging
NEW: Conversation list with synced names and avatars
NEW: Friend requests with Accept/Decline
NEW: **Dark Theme** for OLED devices like the Q10 and Z30
NEW: BlackBerry Hub notifications for both 1-1 and group chats
